title: Instagram Captions Now Get Alt Text and Real Hashtags | vitalii.no
description:
Every image post going out to Instagram had no alt text at all, and the hashtag block was built blind — the prompt had no idea what tags an article actually carried, so it guessed instead. The caption structure also drifted post to post, with no fixed place for the call-to-action or the source line.

post-to-instagram now accepts an altText parameter and sends it to the Instagram Graph API when the image container is created, so every post carries real alt text. assembleInstagramCaption in _shared/facebook-helpers.ts enforces one order every time: body, then a call-to-action, then the source line (skipped when the source is vitalii.no itself), with hashtags always last. generate-social-teasers now passes the article's own tags into the prompt, so hashtags are drawn from real tags instead of invented.

The formula pulls 8 to 12 hashtags from the article's first 125 characters plus its real assigned tags, and every image now ships with alt text instead of none.
